description: Full-depth fan-out artifact for the Workcell product corpus, family: Platform understanding — deployment, worlds, model serving, wayfinder. Companion to the wave-1 whole-first corpus-root journey production/s-products/workcell/sp-workcell.journey.json — the S4 record's own movement path (#0 → #5→0) — which this artifact extends with the remaining inventoried records. Every scene binds one material record from working/expression-corpus/P1-census-workcell.json (frozen-census-basis, 30 records), re-hashed from EpiLogos/Workcell git object storage at published origin/main d911bfd9597f126df6c818cec9641023a06034b1 on 2026-09-21: each bound record is byte-identical to published main; records changed since the census freeze bind their current committed bytes with the delta noted in the binding record. Scene texts compress and quote the records' own headings, never invent claims; tints, formations and layout are declared craft (profiles/family-workcell). Admission: the essay's S register (T25 census, register episteme). Wave-2 fan-out — not a rival admission, not corpus rewrite.
